subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Urban people have a __bombastic__ lifestyle, which is very different from those of rural folks.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pretentious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bombastic"** means using high-sounding but meaningless language, often to impress others; it can also refer to something ostentatious or overly elaborate. (आडंबरपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The politician's bombastic speech was full of grand promises but lacked substance.
 
 
 
• **"Pretentious"** refers to attempting to impress others by acting more important, talented, or cultured than one actually is. (दिखावटी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her pretentious attitude at the party made her seem insincere and arrogant.
 
 
 
• The word "pretentious" captures the essence of "bombastic" better than the other options, as both involve exaggeration or ostentation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pretentious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hollow** (खोखला): Lacking substance, value, or real meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** His apology felt hollow and insincere.
 
 
 
• **Delusive** (भ्रामक): Giving a false or misleading impression.
 
 
• **Example:** The offer of a free vacation was delusive and turned out to be a scam.
 
 
 
• **Common** (सामान्य): Ordinary, usual, or shared among many people.
 
 
• **Example:** It is common to see traffic jams during rush hours in the city.
